summary.en: A wood-look top and an open wire base in one light-looking piece.
summary.zh: 用木纹桌面与通透篮式底座搭配休闲空间。

description.en:
Round tables are shown with wood-look tops and dark open wire bases, including a paired arrangement. The open base gives the furniture a lighter visual outline beside seating.
Confirm the table diameter, height, top material and whether you want a single table or a matching pair.
description.zh:
圆桌采用木纹桌面与深色开放篮式底座，配图也展示双桌搭配。通透底座使家具在座位旁保持较轻的视觉轮廓。
请确认桌面直径、高度、台面材料，以及单桌或双桌组合需求。
